notes.title: Version 0.9.0, Iron, Roofs, Doors, Better textures, & More
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/3fa214e5850ffaa6967d517ae4d1954adb73655d.jpg

Iron

 Iron is added to the game! Now you have another challenge in the game.


Roof & Door for buildings
Added Roof for each building and a door which reveals inside when the protagonist approaches:

 Workshop
 Lab
 Tailor Shop


Effects

 The allies' cloth changing has a new FX.
 The allies' call highlight has a new FX.
 Shadow for buildings and people
 New hit effects for the player, the allies, and the enemies.


Walls Changes

 Walls' sprites have more texture quality.
 Walls have less upgrades count but better upgrades.
 Walls' health outlines are glowing now.
 New guard posts sign for the walls.


Texture Changes

 Tents/Cottages have better textures now.
 The antenna has a better texture.
 Stones have 2 new textures.


Hints

 Hints are now visible in the pause menu. When you forget something, you can return to see the hints.


Menu

 Added Keymap for all devices in the pause menu.
 Bring stats to the pause menu.
 You can see the number of days you survived on Death Screen (red screen on death).


Bug Fix

 Fixed the problem with showing the price.
 Fixed the problem with showing and hiding the research indicator (the bottle) in UI.



Enjoy the weekend!

notes.title: A Massive Update Brings Seasons, Weather effects, Enhancements, and new Enemies!
notes.notes:
Environment Improvements:

 Wind waves will guide you through the game! (Discover the secret!)
 Wind effects now interact with grasses, trees, bushes, and other plants.
 Wind also affects rain, snow, dust, fog, and similar elements.
 Added new tree types
 Added grass to the ground that interacts with wind and objects.
 Added bushes and small trees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/6a366d43c50553d87f7a2ebee7548275b113d509.png

Seasonal Additions:

 Introducing new seasons: Fall, Summer, Spring, and Winter.
 Weather effects added: Rain, Shine, Shooting Stars, Dust, Fog, and Mist.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/cf88e30c11e18495999ef91911004168cea2bfd4.png

Protagonist Enhancements:

 Improved shooting effects, realistic gun recoil, gun muzzle, gun smoke, and visible anger while shooting.
 Shiny bullet visuals.
 Thought balloons for commands when resources are insufficient or when beds are unavailable for recruitment.
 Healing over time
 Danger Effect when the protagonist's health is low.
 Bullets can now hit and scatter raindrops and snowflakes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/41e735999e19fbaf302acbcd8e67a14cd1b130a2.png

Allies Upgrades:

 Shiny bullets for soldiers.
 Enhanced acid explosion effects for scientists throwing acid bottles.
 Healing over time

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/46b09b6c12aef677d7ce2f87d4092082d044d1a0.png

New Enemies: (6 out of 11 enemies completed)

 Healer
 EyeSpider

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/03677a07acae0734729d7d0dac3da11bd1e68ee9.png

Day Cycle Adjustment:

 Adjusted summer day length for better realism.
 Improved time cycle indicators.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/5bd81a7adadb8b5e0f6be6dab13a44f3dff95f15.png

Bug Fixes & Menu Enhancements:

 Resolved shivering parallax effect issue with background trees.
 Added video settings to support devices with lower performance.
 Fixed issues with pause/unpause and input controls.
 Fixed the issue with research upgrade.
 Camera movement upward and better utilization of the empty space at the bottom of the screen.

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update: Seasons, Smarter AI, New Features, and More! 🌟
notes.notes:
Great news! 🎉

The latest update is packed with amazing features:

Seasonal Changes:
Experience the beauty of Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter with dynamic seasonal transitions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/cf88e30c11e18495999ef91911004168cea2bfd4.png

Weather Effects:
Feel the immersive world with wind, rain, snow, auroras, dust storms, fog, and more!

New Environmental Elements:
Enjoy added bushes and grass, making the game world more vibrant and alive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374729/2b81e56516dd4d2b7a78f6c9b3c4cff0b6f9c364.png

Day Cycle Enhancements:
Experience sunrises and an improved day cycle display for a more natural flow of time.

Unlocked Content:
All previously restricted content marked as "Not in Demo Version" is now fully available for gameplay.

Smarter Enemies:
Enemies are now smarter with upgraded AI for tougher challenges.

New Enemies:
Two new foes await: the Healer and the EyeSpider!

DualShock Features:
Enjoy dynamic color changes and vibration feedback on your controller for a more immersive experience.

This update goes live on January 22nd. Get ready for an enhanced adventure and dive into the new world! 🎮✨
